description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Vacation Home: * Private Hot Tub* Short Stroll to the Sugar-White Sands* Convenient private elevator to all levels* Covered porch, multiple balconies, and rooftop terrace for entertaining* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Brozinni Pizzeria, Cafe 30A, Angelina's Italian, or Dough Sea Dough* Under 2 miles to Seaside! * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions * Welcome to Savvy Seagrove on 30A, a beautifully crafted coastal retreat designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable beachside living. With 4 spacious bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, this elegant home offers the perfect setting for a relaxing getaway. From the moment you enter, you’ll be greeted by warm hardwood accents, a soothing coastal color palette, soaring 12-foot ceilings, and the added convenience of a private elevator.The first floor features two king bedrooms, ideal for guests seeking comfort and privacy. One offers a private ensuite bathroom and access to the rear veranda, while the second king bedroom shares a well-appointed hall bathroom. A large laundry room is also conveniently located on this level.Upstairs, the second floor welcomes you with a bright, open-concept living space highlighted by coffered ceilings and abundant natural light. The stylish living and dining areas flow seamlessly into a gourmet kitchen complete with custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, a large island with seating, and a striking backsplash. Step outside to the covered porch where you can dine al fresco, enjoy the coastal breeze, or relax in the outdoor living area. This space also features a fully equipped outdoor kitchen with a built-in gas grill, TV, and wine cooler—perfect for entertaining.The top floor is home to the luxurious master suite, a serene escape featuring vaulted ceilings, elegant finishes, and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub, marble accents, and a walk-in shower. Also on this level is a fun and inviting bunk room with custom full-over-full bunks, a built-in arcade game, and a private ensuite bathroom. Step out onto the third-floor balcony to enjoy your morning coffee or soak up the sun.For the ultimate coastal experience, head up the spiral staircase to the rooftop terrace, where breathtaking Gulf views and unforgettable sunsets create the perfect ending to each day. With its thoughtful design, upscale amenities, and multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces, Savvy Seagrove is the ideal place to relax, entertain, and make lasting memories along 30A.Palmeira Villas at Seagrove Beach is an exclusive, gated community with gorgeous luxury homes, located in the heart of Seagrove Beach on Hwy 30A. Only 1.8 miles from Seaside, this small community offers all the best of 30A without all the hustle and bustle! Hungry? There are many fabulous local restaurants nearby, such as Café 30A, Angelina’s Pizzeria, Dough Sea Dough, and The Perfect Pig Gourmet Market. Come experience Palmeira Villas and see what makes the 30A area world famous!The Bed Setup: 1st Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed w/En-suiteGuest Bedroom: King Bed3rd FloorMaster Bedroom: King Bed w/En-suiteGuest Bedroom: Full-over-full Bunk Bed w/En-suiteArea Attractions: Villa by the Sea is centrally located on 30A with only a short bike ride to the excellent shopping and dining options of Seaside! If you prefer a leisurely stroll, then Café 30A is only minutes away and constantly ranked as one of the best restaurants on 30A. Angelina's is also within walking distance for pasta or pizza. Walk to The Dough Sea Dough for morning donuts or breakfast sandwiches. The Big Chill at Prominence, around 3 miles east, is a great place to take kids, watch an outdoor movie, listen to music, or eat at one of the half a dozen unique eateries.Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
